description: Reviews HCS Trace 0.2.0 topic inspection, live polling, full-topic scans, and exports. Covers direct executables and positional npx/npm exec package invocations, including version suffixes. Direct help narrows only the matching rule; package-launcher help retains review. The CLI reads Hedera data and can write export files locally.
name: HCS Trace
saferAlternatives: Use bounded inspection where possible and choose a new path for file exports.
